title: Fix KeyError from Spotify API response format change
body:
## Summary
- The Spotify API now returns playlist data under `items`/`item` keys instead of `tracks`/`track`, causing `KeyError('tracks')` and `KeyError('duration_ms')` when fetching playlists
- Handle both old and new key names in `getSpotifyPlaylist`, `getUserPlaylists`, and `build_results`
- Use `.get()` for `duration_ms` to gracefully skip tracks missing that field (e.g. local files)

## Test plan
- [ ] Transfer a playlist using `spotify_to_ytmusic create <url>`
- [ ] Transfer all playlists using `spotify_to_ytmusic all <user_id>`
- [ ] Verify playlists containing local files/podcasts don't crash
